title: Japan sought a UAP information-sharing agreement with the US
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Japan sought a UAP information-sharing agreement with the US, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Japan just begged the United States to enter into a bilateral information sharing agreement with the United States solely for the purposes of sharing UAP information

plain: Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on unexplained aerial reports, says that Japan begged the United States for a two-country agreement whose only purpose would be to share information on UAP, the government's term for UFOs. He tells this on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, and if true it would mean other governments take the subject seriously enough to seek formal deals about it.
